topic: Checking In for a Doctor Visit

script.title: CHECKING IN FOR A DOCTOR VISIT
script.story_hook: Checking in and a quick blood-pressure check.
script.intro_zh: 在診所報到並先量血壓、說明原因。
script.welcome_en: Hi friends, glad you came! Today we're checking in at a clinic.
script.welcome_zh: 嗨朋友們，謝謝你們來！今天我們到診所報到。
script.outro: That's all for today! Keep listening and see you next time.
script.outro_zh: 今天就到這裡！繼續聆聽，下次見。
script.practice_intro_en: Now listen and repeat each sentence after me.
script.practice_intro_zh: 現在跟著我，一句一句聆聽並跟讀。
script.char_a_description: a pale young woman in her twenties with a short dark brown bob and bangs, wearing a mustard yellow cardigan over a gray top, holding a small purse in both hands
script.char_b_description: a kind nurse in her forties with auburn hair tied in a bun, wearing soft teal scrubs and a badge on a breakaway lanyard, wrapping a cuff around an arm
script.youtube_title: 【🩺診所報到💗】「這個會痛嗎？」看診報到實用英文📋聽完就會說｜Doctor Check-In English

script.youtube_title_ref: 【🎬沉浸式英文動畫】🩺診所報到英文｜出示保險卡・說明原因・量血壓｜聽完就會說｜🌱A2 初級英文｜💡不用背，多聽就會用｜🎧聽力口說練習｜後段逐句跟讀
script.youtube_description_ref:
📌 影片簡介：
到診所報到，卻聽不懂護士在問什麼？
看診原因、量血壓，用英文到底要怎麼說？

這一集帶大家走進一家診所，跟著病人從出示保險卡、說明看診原因，到量血壓與回報用藥，全程都用自然的美式英語。

你會聽到：
🪪 報到出示證件：例如「Can I see your insurance card?」、「here's my photo ID」。
💬 說明看診原因：例如「What's the main reason for today?」、「headaches and felt dizzy」。
💗 量血壓與用藥：例如「let's check your blood pressure」、「Any medicines you take each morning」。

後半段是逐句聽力加上跟讀練習 🎧，先聽一遍，再跟著一句一句唸，把整段對話變成自然的口語直覺。

🌱 適合 A2 初級英文學習者：不用死背，跟著情境反覆聽，自然就會用。

看完記得實戰一次，原來診所報到可以這麼簡單！

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good morning, I'm here for my nine appointment.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd ˈmɔrnɪŋ aɪm hɪr fɔr maɪ naɪn əˈpɔɪntmənt/
dialogue.zh: 早安，我約了九點來看診。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Morning! Can I see your insurance card?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈmɔrnɪŋ kæn aɪ si jɔr ɪnˈʃʊrəns kɑrd/
dialogue.zh: 早安！能給我看你的保險卡嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Here you go, and here's my photo ID.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɪr ju ɡoʊ ənd hɪrz maɪ ˈfoʊtoʊ aɪˈdi/
dialogue.zh: 給你，還有我的附照片證件。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Thanks. What's the main reason for today?
dialogue.phonetic: /θæŋks wɑts ðə meɪn ˈrizən fɔr təˈdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 謝謝。今天主要的原因是？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I've had headaches and felt dizzy lately.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪv həd ˈhɛdˌeɪks ənd fɛlt ˈdɪzi ˈleɪtli/
dialogue.zh: 我最近頭痛，還覺得頭暈。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Okay, let's check your blood pressure first.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈkeɪ lɛts tʃɛk jɔr blʌd ˈprɛʃər fɜrst/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sure, is this cuff going to hurt?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊr ɪz ðɪs kʌf ˈɡoʊɪŋ tu hɜrt/
dialogue.zh: 可以，這個袖帶會不會痛？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, just sit still and relax your arm.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ dʒʌst sɪt stɪl ənd rɪˈlæks jɔr ɑrm/
dialogue.zh: 不會，坐好、放鬆你的手臂就好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Alright, I'll try to breathe slowly.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yours is slightly high, about one-forty.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɔrz ɪz ˈslaɪtli haɪ əˈbaʊt wʌn ˈfɔrti/
dialogue.zh: 你的血壓有點偏高，大約一百四十。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh, is that something to worry about?
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ ɪz ðæt ˈsʌmθɪŋ tu ˈwɜri əˈbaʊt/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Not yet, but the doctor will review it.
dialogue.phonetic: /nɑt jɛt bʌt ðə ˈdɑktər wɪl rɪˈvju ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 還不會，醫生會幫你看過。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay, that makes me feel better.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Any medicines you take each morning?
dialogue.zh: 你每天早上有吃什麼藥嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Just a vitamin, nothing else really.
dialogue.zh: 就只有綜合維生素，沒有別的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good. Have a seat, she'll call you soon.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd hæv ə sit ʃil kɔl ju sun/
dialogue.zh: 好，先坐一下，她很快會叫你。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thank you, this was really quick.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Of course! Right this way, please.
dialogue.zh: 應該的！請跟我往這邊走。
